title: Where you live and the environment
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a lakóhelyedről, a városi és a vidéki életről, valamint a környezetvédelemről kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, és indokold a véleményedet.

questions.q: What do you like and dislike about the area where you live?
How has your town or neighbourhood changed in recent years?
followUps: Have these changes been positive or negative?

questions.q: Would you rather live in a big city or a small village when you're older? Why?
What are the biggest environmental problems in your area?
How environmentally conscious are you in your everyday life?
Do you think people in Hungary take recycling seriously enough?
Have you noticed any changes in the weather or the seasons in recent years?
Should people be allowed to keep large dogs in blocks of flats? Why or why not?
Who should be responsible for keeping public places clean?
Are you optimistic or pessimistic about the future of the environment? Why?

usefulPhrases.en: It's well connected to the city centre.
usefulPhrases.hu: Jó a közlekedése a belváros felé.

usefulPhrases.en: I try to cut down on plastic.
It's up to all of us.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you like and dislike about the area where you live?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I live on a housing estate on the edge of Debrecen. What I like most is that the Nagyerdő, our huge city park, is only a short bike ride away. What I can't stand is the morning traffic – the buses are always packed and often late.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How has your town or neighbourhood changed in recent years?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Quite a lot, actually. Several big factories have opened nearby, so there are new roads and blocks of flats everywhere, and some green areas have disappeared.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have these changes been positive or negative?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It's a mixed picture. On the one hand, the factories have created thousands of jobs. On the other hand, the air quality has got worse, and the city feels much more crowded than it used to.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How environmentally conscious are you in your everyday life?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd like to think I'm fairly conscious. I sort my rubbish, carry a reusable water bottle and cycle whenever I can. To be honest, though, I still order too many things online, which isn't exactly eco-friendly because of all the packaging.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Are you optimistic or pessimistic about the future of the environment? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Cautiously optimistic. My generation is far more aware of climate change than previous ones, and renewable energy is getting cheaper every year. Having said that, I'm worried that things are changing too slowly.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésre véleményt mond és indokol, saját környezetéből hoz példát (debreceni lakótelep, Nagyerdő, új gyárak), a pozitív vagy negatív változásokról szóló kérdésnél pedig mindkét oldalt kifejti.

Nyelvhelyesség: B2-es szerkezetek pontosan – Present Perfect a változásokra (have opened, has got worse), 'than it used to', a 'What I like most is …' kiemelő szerkezet és a 'which isn't exactly …' mellékmondat.
Szókincs: a téma szavai (housing estate, air quality, reusable, renewable energy) mellett árnyaló kifejezések is (Cautiously optimistic, I'd like to think).
Érdemes megtanulni: „What I can't stand is …”, „It's a mixed picture”, „which isn't exactly eco-friendly”, „Having said that, …”.
